primary_contribution.instructions: What is the paper's primary contribution? Mixed/other applies when no single primary contribution dominates. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.

criteria.method_system: A new method, algorithm, model architecture or system.
criteria.dataset_resource: A new dataset, corpus, annotation set or other reusable resource.
criteria.benchmark_evaluation_method: A new benchmark, evaluation protocol or metric.
criteria.theoretical_result: A theorem, bound, proof or formal analysis.
criteria.empirical_analysis_replication: An empirical study, analysis or replication of existing work.
criteria.synthesis_survey: A survey, review, tutorial or position synthesis of prior work.
criteria.mixed_other: Several contributions of comparable weight, or a kind not listed.
criteria.insufficient_information: Missing content or ambiguity in the supplied text prevents classification.

evaluation_rigor.instructions: How thoroughly does the paper report evaluating its main contribution? Choose the highest point whose description the supplied text meets. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.
criteria: No evaluation of the contribution is reported.
An evaluation in one setting, with no baseline or alternative compared.
A comparison to at least one baseline or alternative is reported.
Baselines and an ablation isolating a component or design choice are reported.
Baselines and ablations are reported, with variation over seeds or runs, intervals or a statistical test.

limitations_candor.instructions: How concretely does the paper state the limits of its contribution? A limitations heading alone is generic. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.
criteria: No limitation or caveat is stated.
A concrete assumption, failure case or scope restriction relevant to the contribution is stated.
Concrete limitations are stated and failure cases are shown.

novelty_as_claimed.instructions: What kind of novelty does the paper claim for its contribution? Record the paper's own claim; do not judge whether it holds. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.
criteria: An incremental improvement or extension of existing work.
A new method for an existing problem.
A new problem, task or capability.
A new paradigm for its field.

claims_supported_by_evidence.instructions: Answer yes if the supplied paper's own text supports this statement: The headline claims are supported by the evidence the paper reports. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.

reproducible_from_materials.instructions: Answer yes if the supplied paper's own text supports this statement: An independent group could reproduce the main result from the materials the paper says it releases. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.

generalizes_beyond_main_setting.instructions: Answer yes if the supplied paper's own text supports this statement: The results are shown to hold beyond the main setting. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.

open_problems_stated.instructions: Answer yes if the supplied paper's own text supports this statement: The paper names questions or gaps it leaves unsettled, in its limitations, future work or open problems. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.
